title: Translation sheet
description: Pipeline step 6 (content/stories/<id>/translations/<lang>.json): one per language after the story's first. It keeps a translation consistent (every name, refrain and recurring word said one way) and gives that language's narrator what the bible and shots.json give the first one: the pitch, the tone, names with pronunciations, personalities, refrains and each page's mood, in that language. The translated text itself is the story's own story/<lang>.json. See tools/prompts/translate.md.

language.description: The language of this sheet, the same as its file name.

from.description: The language it's translated from: the story's first language.

status.description: Draft until a native speaker has read every path in this language. Its narration waits for approval.

pitch.description: The bible's pitch, in this language.

cast.description: Every id in the bible's cast, extras and props -> how this language calls it, and what its narrator needs.

glossary.description: Places and recurring words, as the first language says them -> as this language says them on every page.

moods.description: Image id of every page and ending -> its mood from shots.json, in this language.

name.description: As the text says it, the same on every page.

pronounce.description: How to say it, for this language's narrator: a respelling in this language.

personality.description: The bible's personality, in this language (required when the bible has one).

refrain.description: The bible's refrain, word for word as this language's text says it (required when the bible has one).
